instruction.text: Read the chapter, then answer the questions.

atoms.text: Knut sprinted up and pulled his mum away from the conversation she was having with a neighbour. “Mum, you’re not going to believe this!” he said out of breath and tugging her back down below. “I swear that every other time they weren’t here, but there are bugs eating the bridge glue from underneath!”
atoms.sound: Knut sprinted up and pulled his mum away from the conversation she was having with a neighbour.<voice voice='m9'> “Mum, you’re not going to believe this!”</voice> he said out of breath and tugging her back down below. <voice voice='m9'>“I swear that every other time they weren’t here, but there are bugs eating the bridge glue from underneath!”</voice>

atoms.text: “What!” she yelped, “How can this be happening?” She checked for herself and saw the wee little bugs crawling over her precious bridge. She pulled out her bridgenifier, the special Bridge Troll tool that looked quite similar to a magnifying glass and looked through the lens carefully at the glue. “They’re drilling little holes straight through,” she said while looking as devastated as Knut had ever seen her. “It’s the bridge briars! We have no chance of winning now. They’re ruining the structural integrity of the bridge. We might as well pull out of the competition. The McTrolls will win again.” Knut saw tears welling up in her eyes and felt terrible. He might not have liked her crazed competitiveness, but this was so, so much worse.

atoms.text: “No! We need to figure this out. The bridge briars were not here 30 minutes ago. Where did they come from? We need to warn everyone and see if they also have them!” Knut’s mother agreed that everyone should be warned. She looked back at the bridge with the dust falling down as all her hard work over the last year was slowly eaten away.

atoms.text: Knut left it up to his mum to tell his dad what was happening and instead ran to his bike. The competition was bound to start in the next few hours. If he rode really fast, he just might be able to contact each competitor. He pocketed his mum’s bridgenifier. He had a mission to complete!

b: The little bugs bit her feet.
Her wreaths were ruined by the briars.

His plan is to find out how to control the briars and save the bridges.

atoms.a: What do you think the bridgenifier might be?
b: ++It is a special type of magnifying glass and bridge tool.
It is a piece of stone from the bridge.
It is a floatation device used when looking under bridges.

atoms.a: How did Knut’s mom’s mood change from the beginning of the story until now?
b: ++In the first chapters she was focused and excited. In this chapter she is sad and disappointed.
In the first chapters she was annoyed and frustrated. In this chapter she is happy and content.
She has been angry and upset during each of the first four chapters.
